contributions.description: Collaborated on finishing the recording and arranging manufacture of the release, with preparation underway in Fall 2021. Producer is Casey's description of this work, not a verified printed credit.
Curated the program as a board member of the wulf.
Ran on-site production, including operating the space and running the event. Possible performance participation is recalled by Casey but remains unconfirmed.

Collaborated with Mike Winter to recover a majority of the piece’s data. Copied and typeset the incomplete manuscripts, taking primary responsibility for notation and typesetting decisions. Realized notation from recovered data rather than composing missing music. Prepared the score used for both the Smith Publications edition and the performance recorded for New World Records. Exact printed credits in those publications have not been verified.
Collaborated on data recovery and designed software converting the transcribed data to rough notation.
Composed the music and wrote the original software, which was unavailable to the reconstruction team.

Solely designed and manufactured the printed circuit boards used to drive sound into resonant objects functioning as speakers for Rainforest IV. This credit does not establish involvement in Carolyn Chen's Other Forests, which appeared on the same program.
